edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating untrusted caller into the contract.
constructor invokes _msgSender to obtain the initial owner.
msg.sender becomes _owner during construction, establishing privileged access.
constructor assigns the Uniswap router instance to uniswapV2Router.
constructor stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
constructor performs an external createPair call to the Uniswap factory.
balanceOf reads _rOwned to derive the token balance via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate to convert reflections to tokens.
transfer delegates to _transfer with _msgSender as sender.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before updating allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer triggers reflection balance mutation through _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call that can hand control to an untrusted contract.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution miner-influenceable.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance after swapping.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _marketingAddress.
manualswap lets a privileged address force the swap/external call path at any time.
manualsend lets a privileged address force the external ETH transfer path at any time.
manualswap authorises based on msg.sender equalling the development or marketing address.
manualsend authorises based on msg.sender equalling the development or marketing address.
The external ETH transfer can re-enter the transfer/accounting path if the recipient is a contract.
The external router swap can re-enter transfer accounting before fee/reflection state settles.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to apply balances.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to credit the team fee.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount to the contract's _rOwned entry.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to update totals.
_reflectFee does _rTotal.sub(rFee) on the reflection supply.
_getValues calls _getTValues to compute token-side values.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current reflection rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supply values.
_getCurrentSupply performs rTotal/tTotal division and comparisons that can round or revert.
Fee multiplication/division results flow into _transferStandard balance updates.
Reflection amounts from _getRValues flow into _transferStandard balance updates.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen gate that governs transfer permission.
renounceOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner slot.
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner slot.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes the swap threshold controlling external swap triggering.
toggleSwap writes swapEnabled which gates the external swap call.
setMaxTxnAmount writes the transfer limit checked in _transfer.
setMaxWalletSize writes the wallet cap checked in _transfer.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFee, altering fee bypass.
blockBots writes the blacklist mapping that blocks transfers.
unblockBot writes the blacklist mapping to re-enable an address.
setFee writes buy/sell fee state variables used in transfer accounting.
owner() exposes the privileged _owner for external inspection.
onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership on _owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on _owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates setTrading on _owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates setFee on _owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees on _owner.
_tokenTransfer disables fees before the standard transfer when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer restores fees after the standard transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Boolean parameter is only used to write the tradingOpen gate inside setTrading.
Address array is only consumed by the blacklist loop in blockBots.
Single address parameter only updates the blacklist mapping in unblockBot.
Local sender parameter flows directly into the _transfer accounting logic.
Local recipient parameter flows directly into the _transfer accounting logic.
Amount parameter is validated and split into fees inside _transfer.
Token amount parameter is only used to build and execute the router swap.
ETH amount parameter is forwarded unchanged to the external transfer.
Cached contract balance is used only as the swap input in manualswap.
Cached ETH balance is used only as the transfer input in manualsend.
New owner parameter is written directly into the _owner state variable.
Parameter is written directly into the _maxTxAmount state variable.
Parameter is written directly into the _maxWalletSize state variable.
Account array is iterated to update the _isExcludedFromFee mapping.
Exclusion flag is applied to each account inside the fee-exclusion mapping.
Parameter is written directly into the _swapTokensAtAmount state variable.
Flag parameter is written directly into the swapEnabled state variable.
Fee parameter is written directly into the buy fee state variable.
Recipient parameter is only forwarded to _transfer by the public transfer wrapper.
Sender parameter is only forwarded to _transfer and the allowance update.
